title: The Academy’s Bill Kramer and Lynette Howell Taylor to Attend Tokyo Film Festival
summary: AMPAS is set to have a significant presence at Asia's biggest film event, and will also an event for Academy members.

title: Christian Slater, Trine Dyrholm,  Dree Hemingway Join Dogma25 Feature ‘Incidents of Intimacy’
summary: Johannes Lilleøre, Julie Agnete Vang, Laura Drasbæk and Michael Moritzen will co-star in the low budget drama, directed by Jesper Just under the strict Dogma "vow of chastity."

title: ‘7 Miles Out,’ Starring Lucy Halliday, Tells a Coming-of-Age Story Full of Grief, Music and Friendship
summary: Carol Morley's adaptation of her semi-autobiographical novel about her adolescence near Manchester also stars Gemma Whelan and Aidan Gillen and premieres at the BFI London Film Festival.

title: ‘South Park’ Spoofs Clavicular, Looksmaxxing and Sephora in a Peak-Season Episode
summary: Ike enters an aura battle, Stan gets lost in the Backrooms and Randy gets a face-lift.

title: Iranian Filmmaker Majid Majidi Denounces U.S. War as ‘Midday Meal’ Emerges as Busan Fest Standout
summary: The Oscar-nominated director nearly skipped Asia's leading film festival, but ultimately decided to attend so that he could speak out about the war’s toll on ordinary Iranians.

title: ‘The Lowdown’ Brings a New Case and New Problems for Ethan Hawke’s Lee in Season 2 Premiere
summary: The FX series introduces characters played by Tommy Lee Jones and Betty Gilpin in the opener.

title: Christy Carlson Romano Says She Was Paid Half of Shia LaBeouf’s Salary on ‘Even Stevens’
summary: The actress played Ren Stevens, the older sister to LaBeouf's Louis Stevens on the Disney sitcom, which ran from 2000 to 2003.

title: R.J. Mitte Remembered by ‘Breaking Bad’ Casting Director Sharon Bialy
summary: Bialy reflects on the audition, appeal and legacy of the cerebral palsy-afflicted actor, who she and her partner Sherry Thomas brought to the attention of Vince Gilligan, and who died on Oct. 12 at just 34.

title: Ugg Continues Its High-Fashion Push With JW Anderson’s New Loafer-Inspired Collection
summary: Following its partnership with Willy Chavarria, the footwear brand is keeping its designer collaboration streak alive with two new styles available Oct. 15.

title: Alan Mandell, Esteemed Actor and Interpreter of Samuel Beckett Plays, Dies at 98
summary: He helped stage ‘Waiting for Godot’ (and played Lucky) inside San Quentin State Prison in 1957, then assisted Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter with their recent Broadway revival.
